# descriptive statistic im R

## Distribution of one variable

- The arithmetic mean
- The median
- The mode (usually: the most frequent value)
- The geometric mean (we use it for example to calculate compound average annual rate of growth)
- [Truncated mean](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truncated_mean)

Let us take `head_circ` and `fb_friends` variables from the data and calculate the mean, the median, the geometric mean, the truncated mean (cut 5\% from each tail). 

### central tendency and positional measures

install.packages("psych")
library(psych)

install.packages("modeest")
library(modeest)


View(d$head_circ)
table(d$head_circ)

mean(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE)


median(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)
median(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE)


mode1 <- names(sort(table(d$head_circ), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
mode2 <- names(sort(table(d$fb_friends), decreasing = TRUE))[1]

mode(d$head_circ)


geometric_mean <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) {
  if (na.rm) x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  prod(x)^(1/length(x))
}
geometric_mean(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)


geometric.mean(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)


geometric1 <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) {exp(mean(log(x), na.rm=TRUE))}

geometric1(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)



__Positional measures__

Quartiles, deciles, percentiles. They are all called quaNtiles. 


# quaRtiles:
quantile(d$head_circ, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm=TRUE)
quantile(d$fb_friends, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm=TRUE)

# deciles:
(1:9)/10
quantile(d$head_circ, (1:9)/10, na.rm=TRUE)
quantile(d$fb_friends, (1:9)/10, na.rm=TRUE)

# specific percentiles, for example 65th percentile
quantile(d$head_circ, .65, na.rm=TRUE)

### Dispersion measures

- standard deviation
- variance
- range (max-min)
- IQR ([interquartile range](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interquartile_range)) 
- [mean absolute difference](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mean_absolute_difference)


sd(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE)



var(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)
var(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE)


range(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)
range(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE)

diff(range(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE))
diff(range(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE))

IQR(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE)

mad_mean <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) {
  if (na.rm) x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  mean(abs(x - mean(x)))
}
mad_mean(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)
mad_mean(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE)


library(DescTools)

MeanAD(d$head_circ, na.rm = TRUE)
MeanAD(d$fb_friends, na.rm = TRUE)

mean(abs(d$head_circ - M), na.rm=TRUE)
M <- mean(d$head_circ, na.rm=TRUE)
